Description: Reasoning told in every language Lambek reads (fr, en, de, es, nl, pt, it), the same conversations in each: all and no, a thing that is or does, a chain of two, the fact told first, and what cannot be concluded (a thing never told of, all read the other way, some). Each case is a conversation of its own, measured as bench/messages.json is (Invoke-LambekMessageBenchmark). The calibration split and the test split say the same kinds of things with other words; the test split is frozen: TestHash is the hash of its cases, never edit them while working on Lambek. Written once for step 3e, never learned from.
